serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Little_Richard: Did you read the blog post?
Is he one of those ‘friendly’ types? 
I don’t really like when people are asking me ‘how are you doing?’ and such only because they want to be nice.
AbusedTenant: Yeah, I read it.
Little_Richard: I hope you don’t think that Admin is a goofball after reading it.
Little_Richard: I mean, he’s a goofball, but not in a bad sense.
Little_Richard: Are you getting what I mean?
How the hell am I supposed to answer that? I have no idea what you are trying to say!
Let’s just be compliant. 
AbusedTenant: Sure!
Little_Richard: For some reason I don’t think you are being honest…
…
Little_Richard: What I meant is that Admin really knows his stuff, but he vents too much on the blog. 
Little_Richard: He wants to be as transparent as he can, but it usually just backfires and makes people think he’s incompetent.
AbusedTenant: I see
Well, I’m not a programmer so I have no right to judge that admin guy’s skills.
AbusedTenant: Do you think he can finish it? This AI I mean.
Little_Richard: As it is? No.
AbusedTenant: No? Aren’t you someone with a high rank here? Should you be saying stuff like this?
Little_Richard: I’m just being realistic. I was in a similar organization before and they were pretty close of doing it, or maybe they even finished, but someone betrayed us and everyone got caught.
Little_Richard: All of them were geniuses on their own with far better resources at hand. 
AbusedTenant: Don’t you think it’s futile then? To be a part of this?
Little_Richard: No! And here’s why.
Little_Richard: Admin is really good at what he does and he’s very careful.
Little_Richard: It might take a long time, but if he finds a few people with similar abilities, I’m sure we can make it!
Little_Richard: We recruited a lot of people this time so there might be someone who knows his or her stuff and be of help. We just need to be patient.
AbusedTenant: If you say it like that it makes sense.
Little_Richard: Hahahaha! I’m glad I convinced you!
Little_Richard: gtg, irl stuff is calling
